description: Dataset1.csv - three integer columns with a single header row.

file._note: Precedence: file_id wins outright; then match (glob within folder_id); then file_name. Set match.enabled true and fill folder_id to ingest from a shared drop-folder where names vary.
file._match_note: strategy 'newest' takes the most recently modified match; 'all' ingests every match, each into its own ef_csv_<filename> table unless destination.table_name_override is set. recursive walks subfolders - Drive matches direct children only otherwise. min_modified_time is an RFC-3339 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

header._note: header_row_number is 1-based and counts from the top of the file. Dataset1.csv has its header on the very first line, so 1 is correct.

validation._note: deduplicate_on_primary_key keeps the first occurrence. Leave it false in bronze so duplicates surface rather than being silently dropped.
